Ottoline has made a real leap this year. Her fluency with algebra is now a strength and she explains her method clearly. Next step: check negatives. Ottoline should keep using the Method Check to catch slips.

Mason works hard and his marks show it. In lessons Mason is quick to help others; I would like to see him ask for help himself. With more practice on ratio, he will reach a 6. His partner Kai Wen has been a good influence.

Tegwen's progress this term has been steady rather than spectacular. Her Times Tables fluency is secure; the gap is in fractions. Compared with last year (Tegwen scored 41% in June), she is up 17 points.

Yaw has settled well since joining in January. He is working at the expected level. (Note to self: copied from Dilnoza's comment, check pronouns!) Yaw needs to attempt every question, even the hard ones, and to show his working.

Rose has had a difficult term and her marks dipped. Rose Tuffnell is a bright girl, but with a rose-tinted view of her own work she sometimes skips checking. Mr Vane has moved her seat nearer the front, which should help.

Group comment 10Z: Ibtisam, Callum and Lorna-Jean have formed an excellent revision trio. Callum Prudhoe in particular has grown in confidence and now explains simultaneous equations to the others. Ibtisam should push herself to attempt the last question on each paper.
